#Group 7 STAT1100 Group Project
#1. Introduction

In this project, we use a heart disease dataset to build a decision tree that predicts whether a patient has heart disease (Disease) or not (No_Disease) by splitting the data into two parts: 80% to train the model and 20% to test it. We used 10-Fold Cross-Validation to find the best complexity parameter (CP). Finally we check how well the tree predicts heart disease on the test data.
